correctness.rationale: The four-cube is labelled, paths are unoriented edge sets of 15 edges, and a face switch requires two opposite square edges with replacement still a single spanning path. The source exhaustive enumerator recursively lists every self-avoiding root-zero Hamiltonian path; XOR translations cover every endpoint and canonical edge-mask deduplication counts each undirected path once. Its full 24-face transition test covers every permitted operation, and components are obtained by complete graph traversal. Independently reconstructed the edge table, DFS, translation orbit, squares and switch graph from scratch: 5,712 rooted-zero paths, 45,696 unique paths, 69,120 undirected transitions, 5,184 singleton components, 32 size-528 and 32 size-738 components; reproduced all nine degree multiplicities. Bipartite parity gives only endpoint separations 1 and 3, with 32 unordered pairs of each, and the code partitions these to 672 and 756 states per pair. Finite exhaustive proof applies only to Q4, not Qn.
residual_risks: All Q4 counts are exhaustive finite computation, not a general n-dimensional theorem.
Specialist unpublished/uncatalogued Q4 switch tables or full reconfiguration appendices may duplicate this classification.
